hooks.text: A mystery object from deep space was falling toward Earth.
A three-foot deep-space object triggered impact warnings for Earth.
An incoming killer asteroid turned out to be hollow space debris.

title: The Mystery Object That Struck Earth
description: Astronomers tracked mystery object WT1190F on a crash course with Earth before discovering it was hollow lunar space debris.

beats.text: A mystery object from deep space was falling toward Earth.
beats.visual: Catalina Sky Survey telescope dome at Mount Lemmon under a night sky, 2015
queries: Catalina Sky Survey telescope Mount Lemmon

beats.text: This body was only about three feet wide.
beats.visual: Illustration of a small metallic object floating in the blackness of deep space, 2015

beats.text: It traveled in a wide orbit stretching past the Moon.
beats.visual: Diagram of a highly eccentric Earth orbit extending past the Moon, 2015
queries: eccentric Earth orbit diagram lunar distance

beats.text: But density tests showed it wasn't solid rock.
beats.visual: Abstract data plot showing orbital perturbation due to solar radiation pressure, 2015

beats.text: It was a hollow, discarded tank from a lunar mission.
beats.visual: Artist rendering of a spent rocket stage floating in deep space, 2015

beats.text: The junk hit the atmosphere at nearly 25,000 miles per hour.
beats.visual: Simulation of a space object heating up during high-speed atmospheric entry, 2015
queries: atmospheric entry fire simulation computer model

beats.text: Clouds blocked the view of the fireball over the ocean.
beats.visual: Heavy rain clouds over the Indian Ocean off the coast of Sri Lanka, 2015
queries: storm clouds over Indian Ocean coast Sri Lanka

beats.text: So researchers chartered a business jet to watch it burn.
beats.visual: Exterior shot of a Gulfstream G450 business jet in flight above clouds, 2015

beats.text: They practiced for real asteroids with this mystery object falling toward Earth.
beats.visual: Photograph of the WT1190F fireball disintegrating in the daytime sky, 2015

better_than_last: Integrated reviewer feedback to fix the hook word count and maintained the scale ladder structure escalating from size to entry speed.
